coverageNotes: Does not establish all hook behavior, independent join implementation or a performance benefit from Promise.all.

questions.concept: Preserve the native pagination envelope during hydration
questions.question: Which return statement preserves that result?

options.rationale: Incorrect: replacing the outgoing continuation cursor with the incoming cursor prevents forward progress and yields null initially.
Incorrect: a full page does not mean the query is done. This replaces native completion metadata with an unrelated length test.
Incorrect: native consumers read page. This leaves unhydrated documents in page and adds the names under an unused messages property.
Correct: only page changes. continueCursor, isDone and any optional split metadata are preserved by the spread.
